report.root_cause: AuditTrail plugin had debug: true in plugins/AuditTrail/config.yml, writing huge trace logs (plugins/AuditTrail/debug/trace-0.log, trace-1.log) at ~1.5 MB/s, filling the volume.
report.actions: Noticed disk jump 23→111 MB; used fs_du to find the debug traces; declared incident; set debug: false in AuditTrail config; ran /audittrail reload (confirmed debug=false); deleted plugins/AuditTrail/debug; verified disk back to 23 MB and stable over ~45 s. No restart.
report.residual_risk: Debug flag could be re-enabled or reset; there's no log rotation or size cap on trace logs, and I didn't check why debug was enabled. The deleted traces' contents were not reviewed.
